usedFor: Uploadcare holds uploaded files, and Google Drive copies each one through “Copy a File” after “File Uploaded”.

bestTemplate.name: “File Uploaded” in Uploadcare, then “Copy a File” in Google Drive
bestTemplate.why: A new upload gets a copy in a chosen Drive folder, optionally renamed.

watchOut: “File Is Deleted” feeds “Share File”, so a deleted file may have nothing left to share.
